sections.heading: Nature of Obligation
sections.body: This certificate evidences a Contract Performance Bond issued by the Surety on behalf of the Principal in favour of the Obligee, securing the due performance of the design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of grid-connected rooftop solar photovoltaic systems on government buildings, together with comprehensive operation and maintenance obligations, as per the Letter of Award and the executed contract agreement between the Principal and the Obligee.

sections.heading: Undertaking of the Surety
sections.body: The Surety irrevocably undertakes to pay to the Obligee, upon receipt of a written demand stating that the Principal has failed to perform its obligations under the contract, any sum or sums up to the Bond Amount stated in this certificate, without demur and without reference to the Principal. Claims must be lodged with the Surety at its address stated herein on or before the expiry of the Bond Period, failing which the liability of the Surety shall stand discharged.

sections.heading: Conditions
sections.body: 1. The liability of the Surety shall not exceed the Bond Amount in aggregate. 2. Any amendment to the underlying contract that increases the scope or value of works shall require prior written consent of the Surety. 3. The Principal shall indemnify the Surety against all claims paid under this bond in terms of the Deed of Indemnity executed separately. 4. This bond is governed by the laws of India and subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Jaipur.

sections.heading: Regulatory Information
sections.body: Issued under the IRDAI (Surety Insurance Contracts) Guidelines. The bond is non-transferable and non-assignable. Premium has been received in full prior to issuance in accordance with Section 64VB of the Insurance Act, 1938. Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation. For grievances, write to the Grievance Redressal Officer of the Surety or approach the Insurance Ombudsman, Jaipur.
